history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration conduct a comprehensive cost analysis of the services provided, and comply with relevant cost- recovery guidelines to charge for only necessary and reasonable costs for office rental charges.
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The Administration has decreased the standard rate for the rental of office space for two consecutive years, from $17,000 to $16,000 in 2024 and from $16,000 to $15,000 in 2025, in order to reduce the 10RCR surplus in compliance with relevant guidelines. The new rates for 2025 have not been updated in Umoja. The Facilities and Commercial Activities Service has requested that the new rates be reflected.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has conducted analysis and reduced the rental rate, and that the rental revenue remains substantial in 2024, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
